auto_fail_flags.label: Discount before business outcomes
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller offered a price cut before establishing the business outcome or the case for it.

auto_fail_flags.label: Cost of inaction never raised
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller never framed what the status quo costs the buyer.

artifact: Recorded three-minute commercial reframe with a trap-setting matrix

transition_banner.title: Teach them something they did not know.
transition_banner.body: Reframe the problem before you discuss price.

drills.title: Teach a commercial insight
drills.prompt: Share an insight about the buyer's cost structure, then ask what the number means for their plan.

drills.title: Tailor value to the committee
drills.prompt: Tailor the case to the economic buyer's approval threshold and the criteria that matter to each reviewer.

drills.title: Quantify the cost of inaction
drills.prompt: Make the status quo expensive in the buyer's numbers, then find out what else they are weighing.

boss_fight.title: Boss fight · Commercial reframe
boss_fight.learner_brief: Reframe a Tier-2 deal before the committee discusses price. Hold the cost of inaction in front of all three buyers.
